_comment: Template for keys.free.json — which is COMMITTED, because it holds only public URLs and no credentials. Copy this, point the URLs at your own Workers, and build with --dart-define-from-file=keys.free.json.
_comment_no_secrets: There are deliberately no secrets here any more. The Google Places key lives in the catalog Worker; the bank aggregator's HMAC credentials live in the account Worker. Neither is in the app, and tool/verify_release_apk.py fails the build if one reappears. Earlier versions of this template listed GOOGLE_PLACES_KEY, GOOGLE_ANDROID_PACKAGE, GOOGLE_ANDROID_CERT and three SOPHTRON_* values — all obsolete, and none of them read by the app.
_comment_pro: Optional: add "SWIPEWISE_PRO": "true" to force the Pro UI on for local development. It only decides which tabs are drawn — Pro data comes from the account service, which checks entitlement itself, so forcing this true without an entitlement row yields empty screens.
